EXACT OBSTRUCTION TO DROPPING TRACIAL OUTPUTS / TO A REFERENCE-ONLY LIFT
2026-10-09. Internally reconstructed analytic witnesses. Not a counterexample
to the legal unital, HS-self-adjoint broadcasting target.

Use the Ji matrices in SPIN1_SUPPORT_THEOREM.txt and weights (1,1,0).
Then V=4/3, k=8/9, and V+k=20/9 exactly.
On the two outputs B,C set Li=Ji(B)+Ji(C). In their total-spin-two
subspace take v=|j=2,m_z=0>. Thus

 L3 v=0,  <v|L1^2|v>=<v|L2^2|v>=3,
 <v|L2 L1|v>=0,  <v|Li|v>=0.

In the J3 eigenbasis |+>,|0>,|-> of each spin-one output,

 v=(|+,->+|-,+>+2|0,0>)/sqrt(6).

1. EXPLICIT ISOMETRIC BROADCASTER

Define U:C^3 -> C^3 tensor C^3 by

 U e1 = -i L2 v / sqrt(3),
 U e2 =  i L1 v / sqrt(3),
 U e3 = v.

The displayed expectation identities show that the three images are
orthonormal. They all belong to the symmetric total-spin-two subspace.
Therefore B(X)=U X U^dagger is CPTP with equal two marginals. Its normalized
pure Choi state is |psi><psi|, where

 psi=(-i|e1> L2 v+i|e2> L1 v)/3 + |e3>v/sqrt(3).

The reference marginal is I/3. In the real vector basis Ji^T=-Ji, so
the star observable is

 H=-J1(A)L1-J2(A)L2.

Its only nonzero reference blocks are H13=-iL2, H31=iL2,
H23=iL1, H32=-iL1. Direct substitution gives

 <psi|H|psi> = 2/sqrt(3)+2/sqrt(3) = 4/sqrt(3).

This exceeds 20/9, since 4/sqrt(3)>20/9 is equivalent to
36>20sqrt(3), or 1296>1200 after squaring positive sides.

The BC marginal is the uniform mixture of the total-spin-two states
with m_z=-1,0,1. To see this, the normalized vectors L1v/sqrt(3)
and L2v/sqrt(3) form an orthonormal basis of the span of |2,+1>,|2,-1>.
For each of |2,+1> and |2,-1>, an individual output has populations
(1/2,1/2,0) or (0,1/2,1/2) in its J3 eigenbasis. For |2,0> the
populations are (1/6,2/3,1/6). Their uniform mixture is

 rho_B=rho_C=diag(2/9,5/9,2/9) in the J3 eigenbasis,
            =diag(2/9,2/9,5/9) in the real vector basis.

Consequently its marginal channel Phi is NOT unital:
Phi(I/3)=rho_B != I/3. A TP HS-self-adjoint map is unital, so this
Phi is also not HS-self-adjoint. This is an admissible counterexample
only to a weakened claim that retains a tracial reference and equal
outputs while dropping tracial output marginals.

On the tested frame, s_Phi=<H>/2=2/sqrt(3), and the ratio is

 (V-k)/(V-s_Phi) = 4/3 + 2sqrt(3)/3 > 2.

This ratio does not falsify the authorized legal-channel gate because
